thread:
emily: FYI pushing a coordinated release Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. Cross-service dependency: router prewarm -> runtime roll -> api rollout -> console. Need explicit handshake and rollback steps.

rafael: noted. why router first?

emily: router header split and route-table prewarm reduces client-side 503s when runtime scales. also lets us validate routing rules before traffic hits new runtime.

jia: sounds fine. pin matrix?

emily: proposed pins: router header-split v1.10 (can roll back to v1.9), runtime v4.2 (fallback v4.1), api v2.20 (last stable v2.19), console minor (feature-flagged telemetry).

amir: canaries: router 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%; runtime 1% -> 15% -> 60% -> full; api 1% -> 20% -> full; console hold at 10% until post-router full. Keep steps small.

deploybot: PRECHECKS: config-lock OK, infra-headroom OK, schema-compat NOK (console telemetry optional field changed).

jia: console change behind flag, acceptable. add migration guard to console API client to ignore new optional field.

rafael: ops note: router header swap previously caused KV misses. Recommend bump cache TTLs to 30m for the during-ramp and enable conservative eviction on runtimes for 1h post-deploy.

emily: added TTL bump and runtime eviction guard to playbook.

amir: monitoring thresholds for auto actions? need exact numbers.

infra-bot: ALERT CONFIG FOR WINDOW:
- request_error_rate > 1.5% for 4m => page #platform-oncall
- p95 latency +50% vs baseline for 3m => notify #infra
- runtime CPU > 85% on >=3 hosts for 5m => auto-scale + block next wave
- OOM events >=2 in 10m => rollback runtime to v4.1

emily: manual abort clause: CS or major customer reports outage => immediate pause and pin back to last-stable across services.

jia: rollback commands for quick runbook copy?

emily: adding snippets now:
```
# router rollback to 1.9
deploybot rollback --service router --to-version 1.9 --note "header-swap fail"
# runtime rollback to 4.1
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version 4.1 --note "health triggers"
# api pin to 2.19
deploybot pin --service api --version 2.19 --note "emergency pin"
```

rafael: I'll rehearse those in staging today.

deploybot: SCHEDULE:
- Dry-run canary at 01:45 UTC
- Wave 1 (router) 02:00 UTC
- Wave 2 (runtime) 02:20 UTC
- Wave 3 (api) 03:00 UTC
- Wave 4 (console) 04:00 UTC

amir: keep a 15m soak between major waves. If any auto-action fires, halt progression and trigger oncall.

emily: agreed. I'll post runbook link and update release notes. Please respond with ack and which metric you'll watch.

jia: ack. watching console schema logs and telemetry feature-flag ramp.

rafael: ack. watching router cache hit-rate and kv miss metrics.

amir: ack. watching runtime CPU, eviction rate, and OOMs.

deploybot: REMINDER: quiet-window 02:00-05:00 UTC. All non-critical merges blocked.

emily: thanks team. Posting runbook: https://internal/redwood/releases/1766019999-runbook. Ending thread. :rocket:
